test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

A man who is womanish in his habits
solution:
The correct answer is: **Effeminate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "effeminate" (स्रैण) is the correct option as it accurately represents a man who exhibits characteristics, behaviors, or traits that are traditionally associated with women.
 
• Such a man may have habits, mannerisms, or interests that are considered stereotypically feminine.
